name: session-journal
description: Record Claude Code and Codex sessions to an Obsidian vault (or a subfolder of an existing one): one daily journal note (Journal/<date>.md) with a chronological summary block per MEANINGFUL session (throwaway sessions skipped, no verbatim transcript, no hook-generated wiki). The bulky raw event log lives OUTSIDE the vault (under $XDG_STATE_HOME/session-journal) with retention. Every note is tagged #ai-generated to stay distinct from hand-authored notes. Includes an explicit skill for LLM-Wiki lesson drafts and aggregated Slack reporting.
